lines.en: label beachfive12:
scene beachsleepyay1
BUT THAT DOESN’T MATTER ANYMORE BECAUSE IT’S SUDDENLY TIME TO FUCKING PARTYYYYY!
: Attention friends! If you are hearing me right now, it means you’ve been invited to the slumber party to end all slumber parties! Perhaps even somewhat literally!
: Thanks for having us! But you might want to tone it down a little because, at this rate, everyone down the hall might hear you as well and we’ll need to get more futons.
: Nah. Whoever shows up next can have mine. You didn’t tell me there were going to be other people here- let alone a live predator.
scene beachsleepyay2
: I think she’s talking about you, Sensei.
: Yeah, she does that a lot.
: Yumi, be nice. It took an incredible amount of bravery for Sensei to even come here. The least you can do is wait until he wrongs you to start talking bad about him.
: He wronged me the second I walked through the door because I made the foolish decision to think I was free from wrapping my chest tonight.
: And we’re all very thankful for that.
: Yeah, you’re kinda huge. And standing next to Sana just makes that even more apparent.
scene beachsleepyay3
: I’m at a...severe disadvantage because of...my height.
: Tell that to Uta. She’s only an inch taller than you and she’s packing heat.
scene beachsleepyay4
: But we’re not here to compare breast sizes!
: Can we still do it later, though? Preferably with adult supervision so nothing gets out of hand?
: Maybe! But not until we’ve gotten what we need to do out of the way first!
: And the fuck is it that we need to do? Noriko didn’t tell me there was a fuckin’ objective to this bullshit- just that there was gonna be food.
: In all fairness, I don’t really know what the objective is either. I just heard “slumber party” and “Sensei” in the same sentence and signed both of us up.
: You’re not...going to make us study...are you?
scene beachsleepyay5
: It’s less about studying and more about trying to figure out if any of you are capable of bearing knowledge that the world we live in is an infinitely looping-
: Yeah, whatever. When does the food get here?
: That we live in a world where-
: I’m kind of hungry too. Do you think UberEats delivers to the beach?
scene beachsleepyay6
: This may be harder than I anticipated.
: Correct me if I’m wrong, but wasn’t Nodoka supposed to come as well?
scene beachsleepyay7

: Fuckin’ good thing she didn’t. It’s bad enough havin’ to sleep in the same fuckin’ building as that guy. If four-eyes was here, y’all would have to worry about figuring out how to clean blood off tatami.
: Water and vinegar. Wipe with the weave, not against it.
scene beachsleepyay8
: Why do you know that?
: Just in case!
: I wanted Nodoka to come, yeah. But I was looking for her all day and couldn’t find her.
: She only just turned up a little while ago, but Futaba says she needs her rest or something and that it would be best to leave her alone. Which I guess is good for Yumi’s sake.
: Don’t worry about Nodoka. She was with me earlier and she knows...way more than you’d expect about what’s going on.
scene beachsleepyay9
: Ah. So that’s what I heard when I tried to drop by earlier.
: What do you mean she “knows more than we’d expect?” Were you actually able to talk to her about this?
: Talk about what? You ain’t said fuck-all about why you need a goddamn slumber party just to tell us shit. And why us in the first place? I don’t even like you people.
: False. You like me.
: No, I tolerate you. It’s different.
scene black
: I already tried to tell you! But successfully doing that is going to take some amount of work, so...
: For now, why doesn’t everybody make themselves comfortable so I can reconvene with Sensei and Makoto and figure out how we’re going to tackle this! Slumber party team, disperse!
: Just make sure to only disperse throughout the room since I don’t want to go track any of you down again. Looking at you, Yumi.
: Yeah, fuckin’ everybody is lookin’ at me tonight.
: And this is precisely why you should ditch the sarashi for good and accept that you are gifted.
scene beachsleepyay10
: You perverted fuckin’...where’s the goddamn food?!
: So...what’s going on with Nodoka? Were you actually able to get through to her earlier?
scene beachsleepyay11
: Yeah, what? You didn’t mention anything about handling her on your own during our meeting. What does she know?
: She managed to figure out that we’re caught in a time loop.
scene beachsleepyay12
: What?! How?!
: What do you mean “how?” This is Nodoka we’re talking about. If you locked her in a padded room by herself and told her to come up with a cure for cancer, she’d be done in a week.
: Someone should definitely lock her in a padded room then. For the greater good.
: To be honest, I’m not even fully convinced she’s human. And that’s even more true now that she’s apparently managed to piece together all of the weird time-related stuff happening to us.
scene beachsleepyay13
: It’s not all of it.
: She said a lot of stuff I didn’t understand either, but...for the most part, it seems that she understands that something is wrong. And that’s more than anyone else has been able to do so far.
: So if she’s not here, it’s fine. And at this rate, trying to tell her anything would probably cause her to freak out even more than she already was earlier. That’s another thing, though...
: Even if she does know something...figuring out more about it seems nigh impossible since she’s still dealing with that same sort of thing everyone else does when we try to tell them.
: Just, instead of immediately changing the subject, she has to fight away some sort of headache or something.
scene beachsleepyay14
: But it’s still the same sort of countermeasure...which calls into question whether or not she’s unable to follow her train of thought to its last stop because she simply isn’t meant to know or if-
: If there’s some kind of supernatural entity or force physically preventing her from knowing!
scene beachsleepyay15
: Sure. If you actually believe in that sort of nonsense.
: How can you not? We’re effectively time travelers. The existence of the supernatural would be like a four on the weird scale at this point.
: Plus, you remember Big Boi, don't you?
: I try not to.
: So you do remember. What was he if not supernatural?
: ...Big Boi?
: Some...hallucination, I assume. But if you'd give that thing a four, what would a ten be?
: A world where Sensei is gay.
scene beachsleepyay16
: Okay. Fair.
: Really? That would be the most unbelievable thing that could possibly happen?
: Yeah. You’ve been in probably like a million, trillion different timelines and I don’t think you’ve slept with a boy in any of them.
scene beachsleepyay17
: Yeah, because I’m still me in all of them. And men are in short supply around here.
: Don’t worry, Sensei. I prefer only having to compete against one sex for your love.
: I’m not worrying, I’m-
: Listen, as fun as it would be for the three of us to talk about the possibility of Sensei one day having sex with a man, we have bigger things on our plate right now.
scene beachsleepyay18
: That wouldn’t be fun at all...
: Makoto’s right. So, getting back on track, there are two ways I figure we can handle this.
scene beachsleepyay19
: Option one — we treat this like a normal slumber party, but sort of...pepper in comments throughout the night that hopefully plant some kind of seed in the other girls’ minds.
: Nodoka’s special, sure. But if she was able to figure things out on her own, maybe that’s how it has to be in order to work? Maybe we just can’t literally tell them?
: So the idea would just be to...provide a bunch of hints? Point out the fallacies and contradictions in this current timeline and hope they can somewhat comprehend all of that?
: Pretty much, yeah.
: Well, what’s the second option? Because you clearly have more faith in our classmates’ intellect than I do.
: The second option would be to do what we’ve done in the past in just literally attempting to explain things. The issue there is that this slumber party is a lot different from the last.
: Last time, we had a couple girls who already stopped interrupting us any time we tried to talk to them. And, while we still don’t know why, that method did have its pros and cons.
: The key “pro” here would be getting additional insight or fresh perspectives on what all of this could possibly mean, ultimately pointing us in a new or better direction.
: And a key “con” would be?
: The world explodes again.
scene beachsleepyay20
: Hmm...that is a pretty big con.
: What do you think, Sensei? Pepper in some hints? Or go all-in and try to break through with brute force?
: I guess that depends on if we want to try to provoke another reset since that’s what happened last time we did this. But if none of us can sense one coming...
: Maybe we could try a mixture of both? Pepper in hints and then...try to make them hop on that train of thought so those hints don’t just get thrown out?
: That’s sort of what I did with Yumi and Tsuneyo last time. Just...tried to remind them of stuff and...went from there.
scene beachsleepyay21
: In that case, why don’t we split up? Doing such a thing in a group setting would only make it harder to stick to one specific subject as it risks someone else attempting to change it.
: Sensei, you can handle Yumi again since you’ve had success with her in the past.
: I think that’s a good idea. Which means I should try talking to Sana since the two of us are already close.
scene beachsleepyay22
: That leaves me with Noriko, then. Which seems like the slimmest connection out of our three pairs...but I’ll see what I can do regardless.
: Can I have a minute or two to come up with a plan? It’d be strange if I were to just...approach her, wouldn’t it?
: Not really. Noriko’s super approachable — even for someone with a low charisma stat like you.
: I could just leave altogether if that’s what you’d prefer? It’s not as if I have anything to gain from participating in this.
: I apologize for everything. You may take as much time as you need.
scene black
: In fact, let me come up with something as well. Sana’s super easy to talk to once you understand her, but she also gets bored really easily. Sensei!
: Huh? What?
: You’re up. Go mingle.
: I thought my role was just talking to Yumi?
: It is! But you need to buy us some time and keep everybody occupied so no one thinks this is a lame party and leaves.
: But-
: Go! Do what you do best!
scene beachsleepyay23
: Uhh...
: Sup, ladies?
: I suddenly have to go to the bathroom. Goodbye.
scene beachsleepyay24
: Well, that didn’t pan out how it was supposed to.
: She’ll be back, don’t worry. She just feels a little...out of place right now. Which is definitely my fault since I may have kinda tricked her into coming, but still.
: Right...
: Y...Yeah...
: So, uhh...
: Do you guys want to, like...sit down?
scene beachsleepyay25
: Can I sit on your lap? If yes, I agree. If no, I also agree. I just really like spending time with you.
: Probably not right now. I’m just trying to buy time.
: Time for what, exactly?
scene beachsleepyay26
: Doesn’t matter. Thank you for joining me on the floor.
: The floor is the best place to do it. There’s so much surface area.
: That...is correct. Except we are not “doing it” right now. We’re just talking. About normal things until Ayane and Makoto are finished getting ready.
: Getting ready for what?
: That doesn’t matter either.
: If we’re having an orgy, we really should wait for Yumi to get back. She plays hard-to-get, sure. But I can tell she’s just as sexually frustrated as the rest of us.
: Sana, can you help me out here? I can’t fend off Noriko’s untimely hormones in a way that would benefit the current situation very much.
: If we’re having an orgy, I want to go first.
scene beachsleepyay27
: Damn, Sana! Can’t you at least make an exception for a girl that’s been waiting to get all up in his business for over half her life?!
: No. He’s acting strangely and only I can fix him.
: I am?
: Yes. And only I can fix you.
scene beachsleepyay28
: Come to think of it, this does feel pretty weird. It’s not really like you to call for slumber parties with select girls. Even if Ayane is...technically the one who called for it?
: But you’re clearly in on whatever’s going on here, so...would you mind just explaining it to us instead of stalling for time?
: Yeah...would you mind doing that, Sensei?
: I mean...sure. But at the very least, can we also point out that Sana is being weird right now too?
scene beachsleepyay29
: I’d have agreed up until recently. Now, I have no idea who she even is anymore.
: Why don’t you stay here and talk to me while Ayane goes and talks to Yumi? I like that plan more than the one you guys came up with.
scene beachsleepyay30
: Huh?
: You...heard that?
: It’s a small room.
scene beachsleepyay31
: Heard what? What’s going on with you and Yumi?
: How much did you hear?
: Enough for me to feel very confused.
: It would be nice if someone smart and experienced in teaching would tell me more about it.
: Oniichan, translation?
: The translation is that Sana might be in for a bit of a wild ride tonight.
scene beachsleepyay32
: Fine, she can go first! But if I’m any later than third, I’m going to be very upset!
: I mean with Ayane.
scene beachsleepyay33
: Ooh, nice. I want to watch.
: Wait, what? Ayane? You’re still-
: We can talk later if you want. Ayane’s the one you want right now. And she’s the one you’re going to get since neither of them will be able to break through to Yumi.
: But-
: She’ll be way better at talking about this than I am anyway. And if you’re already starting to catch on, I’m sure things will go plenty smoothly.
scene beachsleepyay34
: Uhh...sorry to interrupt, but I’m starting to feel a little out of the loop here.
: Yeah. That’s exactly why we’re having this thing.
: This...sounds kind of serious all of a sudden. Is everything okay?
: Yeah...everything’s fine. And everything will probably stay “fine” forever because that’s how this world works.
: We’ll live through this same exact school year over and over and-
: Are you sure everything’s fine? Because it really doesn’t seem fine.
: And there’s no way it’ll ever come to an end because the world itself won’t let it come to an end-
: Are you sure everything’s fine? Because it really doesn’t seem fine.
scene beachsleepyay35
: We’re all part of a loop that-
: Are you sure everything’s fine? Because it really doesn’t seem fine.
: Do you see, Sana? This is what we were talking about.
: Is she...broken?
scene beachsleepyay36
: What do you mean “broken?!” I might be a little messed up, but I’m still an energetic and driven young girl who is only kind of confused when it comes to-
: Time loop.
: What do you mean “broken?!” I might be a little messed up, but I’m still an energetic and driven young girl who is only kind of confused when it comes to love and where to go from here!
: Woah.
: Yeah. So that’s basically what we’re dealing with.
scene beachsleepyay37
: And Ayane can-
: Ayane can do everything I can. Probably more. And if luck is on our side, this is a thing we’ll be able to talk about a lot in the future. So long as you don’t replace me, that is.
: But how would I-
: Talk to her. I have to go look for Yumi.
scene beachsleepyay38
: Let me come with you! Yumi and I are friends now and-
: You stay here and bond with Makoto. She’s not really close with anyone here and is probably feeling lonely.
scene beachsleepyay39
: Ah...okay. Yeah. If that’s what you want, Sensei. I can do that.
: Sensei...
: I really...would like to talk to you later...
scene black
: And you will so long as the world doesn’t explode while I’m gone. Ayane, are you ready yet?
: Yup-yup! Sana, come! Look, I have chocolate!
: Guh...a targeted attack...
: Noriko, if you have a minute, would you-
: Mm!
Noriko latches onto my waist just as I attempt to leave the room.
: Ooooor I can wait...
: Noriko? What are you doing?
: I don’t know...
: I just felt like I had to do this.
: Are you sure everything’s fine?...
: Because it really doesn’t seem fine.
: It’s complicated...but yeah.
: Everything is fine.
Noriko reluctantly releases me, and I pat her on the head before taking a step back.
She doesn’t say anything else, but there’s a fear in her eyes I haven’t quite seen from her before.
Call it intuition if you will. Maybe she really can sense that something is amiss here.

But I’ve found that more often than not, intuition turns to premonition in this city. And that if this sentimental foresight whispers to her a hidden truth of this world, it will not be hidden for long.
Sana looks at me as well.
There is no fear in her eyes, but hunger.
I’m confused by her appetite, though.
Most don’t ask for seconds when someone spits in their mouth.
